name: As genuine as a three-dollar bill

meaning.zh:
“假到不行” 或 “完全不是真的”。

这个短语的出处在于美国没有真正的三美元纸币，因此，任何所谓的三美元纸币必然是假币。所以，当需要形容某事物或者某个人完全不可信不真实时，人们会使用这个短语。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the fact that there is no genuine three-dollar bill in the United States. Therefore, any supposed three-dollar bill must be a counterfeit. Hence, the phrase is commonly used to describe something or someone as completely untrustworthy or fake.

lines.en: His apology was *as genuine as a three-dollar bill*.
lines.zh: 他的道歉和三美元钞票一样假。

lines.en: That offer sounds *as genuine as a three-dollar bill*.
lines.zh: 那个报价听起来和三美元钞票一样不可信。

lines.en: Her compliments are *as genuine as a three-dollar bill*.
lines.zh: 她的赞美和三美元钞票一样虚伪。
